query: gitlab company valuation, most recent funding round raised, and any recent layoffs
markdown:
GitLab is a **public company** (NASDAQ: GTLB), so it no longer has private funding rounds in the traditional sense. [0] [1]

**Current valuation:** Market cap of **~$7.8–8.2B** as of late September / early October 2026. [0]

**Most recent funding round:** The last private round was a **$268M Series E in September 2019** at a **$2.75B** post-money valuation, led by ICONIQ Capital and Goldman Sachs. [2] [1] [0] [3] [4] Post-IPO, there was a **PIPE round in November 2023** (investor: Ooredoo, amount undisclosed) and a **post-IPO round in September 2022** (undisclosed). Total raised across all rounds: ~$435M.

**Recent layoffs:** In **late September 2026**, GitLab cut **350 employees (~14% of workforce)** alongside Q2 FY27 results (revenue $286.3M, up 21% YoY). [5] This followed an earlier **May 2026 restructuring** announcement that eliminated up to three layers of management and expanded AI automation, with shares falling ~7% after-hours on that news. [6]
